evals.prompt: I'm meeting with the procurement team at Caterpillar next week (caterpillar.com) and I want to give them something personalized to take away. My company sells AI-powered parts inventory forecasting — check project44.com as a rough stand-in for the kind of B2B SaaS vibe we have. My name is Alex Chen, email alex@supplysmart.io, phone +1 (415) 555-0192. Generate a personalized sales microsite for them.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file named outreach-caterpillar.html (or similar) with 3 sections: intro, challenges, and industry trends. The page should reference Caterpillar's manufacturing/heavy equipment industry, include Alex Chen's contact info in the CTA section, and contain mobile-first dark-themed design with a bottom nav bar.

assertions.name: html_file_created
assertions.description: An HTML file was saved to the output directory

assertions.name: prospect_name_in_title
assertions.description: The page title contains the prospect company name

assertions.name: three_sections_present
assertions.description: All three section IDs exist in the HTML

assertions.name: bottom_nav_present
assertions.description: Bottom navigation bar is present

assertions.name: contact_email_present
assertions.description: Salesperson's email is in the contact section

assertions.name: mobile_viewport
assertions.description: Mobile viewport meta tag is present

assertions.name: industry_specific_language
assertions.description: Content references manufacturing or supply chain (not just generic B2B copy)

assertions.name: no_unfilled_placeholders
assertions.description: No {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens remain in the output
